core_obligations: Local generation: at a point of the space the first clause of coherence gives an open neighbourhood and finitely many sections whose associated map from a finite direct sum of the structure sheaf is surjective (proof lines 1820-1824)

Local relations: on a possibly smaller neighbourhood the second clause of coherence gives finitely many sections of that finite direct sum generating the kernel of the surjection (proof lines 1825-1828)

Assemble the presentation: over that neighbourhood the two families of sections form a presentation of the module by two finite direct sums of the structure sheaf, which is exactly finite presentation; quasi-coherence is the recorded consequence (proof lines 1828-1841)
proof_roadmap: 取 x ∈ X。由凝聚性定义 (1) 得邻域 U 与 s_1,…,s_n 使 ⊕O_U → F 满。
由定义 (2) 得更小邻域 V 与其核的有限生成元 t_1,…,t_m，于是 ⊕O_V^{⊕m} → ⊕O_V^{⊕n} → F|_V → 0 即有限表现；再由有限表现蕴含拟凝聚得到结论。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement deduces finite presentation, and hence quasi-coherence, from coherence on a ringed space (author lemma at source lines 1812-1817, label lemma-coherent-finite-presentation). The proof (source lines 1819-1842) unfolds the definition of coherence: the first clause gives local generation of the module by finitely many sections, the second clause gives local generation of the kernel of the resulting surjection, and together they exhibit the presentation by two finite direct sums required by finite presentation (proof lines 1820-1841). The two-step unfolding of the definition is the content. H2.
